QuestInfo.name: Alcaster's Cape
QuestInfo.0: There is an elder who is over 300 years old in El Nath, and he can make a magically-enchanted cape that blocks all coldness... An elder who is older than 300 years old? #b#p2020005##k is the only person you can think of. Go to #p2020005#.
QuestInfo.1: The person who gave #p2020003# the cape was indeed #p2020005#. The one that #p2020003# had in his possession turned out to be the #t1102109#, which #p2020005# made to combat the cold when he came to #m211000000# to research. After asking for the cape, #p2020005# said he would make a new one for you if you bring him the materials.
QuestInfo.2: You brought all the materials back to #p2020005#, and in return, he gave you #t1102109#, a magic-laced cape designed to combat even the toughest weather. Now you can totally hunt in #m211000000#!

0.0: I've been studying magic for over 300 years, but I see no end to it... Hmm? Who are you? ...What's that about #p2020003#'s cape? #p2020003#... #p2020003#... Ahh, you must mean the gentleman in front of #m211000000# who couldn't withstand the cold weather.
0.1: I went to #m211000000# to study magic, but it was unbearably cold, so that's why I made the cape. Over 300 years, I built up a tolerance to the cold, so I gave the cape to the young man. Hmm? You want one, too? Oh... well, that was the only one I had. If you do want me to make one, I'd need you to gather materials for me.

yes.0: I need 4 #t4021000#, 2 #t4006000#, 50 #t4000087#, and 20 #t4000051#. That's all it takes to make you a cape. I'll make you as many as you need.

no.0: You must be having trouble gathering the materials. That's unfortunate. Let me know when you are ready to get some. I'll tell you the materials required to make the cape.
